description: Playbook for building a 100%-client-side, in-browser neuroimaging tool (QSMbly / NeuroDesk style) by porting a reference Python/MATLAB pipeline to Rust + WebAssembly. Use when the goal is a drag-and-drop web app that reads DICOM/NIfTI, processes entirely in the browser (no upload, PHI-safe), and downloads NIfTI/DICOM, with the numeric core validated bit-for-bit against the reference. Covers workspace layout, the bit-exact parity gotchas, DICOM/NIfTI I/O, single-vs-BIDS input modes, a BIDS batch mode with a permanent docked viewer, the review-first download flow, privacy, GitHub Pages + NeuroDesk deploy, and the adversarial multi-agent review discipline.
